text:
Situation: Ertapenem 1 g injection is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 448 vials at 14.9 vials per day (30 days on hand). Corvale General holds two lots totaling 722 vials at 33.2 vials per day (21.7 days on hand combined).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list does not include ertapenem as of 2026-10-21. A registered manufacturing plant, ACS Dobfar SpA (FEI 3006028606) in Italy, received a VAI classification on its most recent inspection ending 2024-12-13. That plant previously received an OAI classification on an inspection ending 2016-01-19 and a Warning Letter dated 2017-01-13.

Our position: Current inventory covers 21 to 30 days across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Multiple manufacturers not on the shortage list are available for purchase, though their labels do not name placeable plants.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. (ranked option 1) to replenish stock at both campuses. Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify BluePoint Laboratories (ranked option 2) and Dr.Reddys Laboratories Inc. (ranked option 3) as backup sources. Requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and ACS Dobfar inspection updates weekly. Requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
